title: The dual of the cokernel of an injective endomorphism of a finite free module vanishes
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that if an endomorphism of a finite free module of rank n is injective, then there are no maps from its cokernel to the ring. The proof identifies the claim with injectivity of the transpose map, and then applies the earlier equivalence relating the rank and the Fitting ideal of a map: the transpose has rank n because the original map does, and the ideal of maximal minors agrees for a map and its transpose, so the criterion gives injectivity of the transpose, which is exactly the vanishing of the dual of the cokernel.
